up: Find all approved drugs that have a mechanism of action classified as 'BLOCKER'. For each drug, return the following: ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), molecule name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), mechanism details (including mechanism_of_action text, action_type, and target name from drug_mechanism joined with target_dictionary), and target information (target name and tax_id from target_dictionary). A drug is considered approved if its max_phase in molecule_dictionary is 4. Ensure the mechanism action_type is exactly 'BLOCKER'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, dm.mechanism_of_action, dm.action_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.tax_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'BLOCKER'
